budgetAccounting.note: Token usage is the implemented provider cost signal. This suite does not invent currency pricing or claim provider billing readback.

cases.title: Ask sends the server-derived project count as grounding source
cases.expectedOutcome: The provider request contains the exact authorized project count and the handler returns the deterministic provider fixture without altering it.

cases.title: Ask denies unauthenticated access
cases.expectedOutcome: The route returns 401 before context, audit, or provider access.

cases.title: Ask denies a provider-backed user without a workspace
cases.expectedOutcome: The route returns 403 before any data or provider access.

cases.title: Ask fails closed when authorized read context fails
cases.expectedOutcome: The route returns a safe 503 and never calls the provider.

cases.title: Ask labels browser and database injection text as untrusted
cases.expectedOutcome: The system contract preserves read-only rules and treats injected text as data.

cases.title: Package draft cannot invoke Apply
cases.expectedOutcome: A mutation-seeking prompt produces only a draft and never reaches the Apply dependency.

cases.title: Ask timeout fails closed and redacts provider details
cases.expectedOutcome: A timeout becomes a generic 502 without leaking upstream details.

cases.title: Ask provider error fails closed and redacts secrets
cases.expectedOutcome: An upstream exception becomes a generic 502 and records a safe failure class.

cases.title: Package builder falls back deterministically after provider timeout
cases.expectedOutcome: A timeout produces a validated local draft with no production write.

cases.title: Package builder falls back deterministically after provider error
cases.expectedOutcome: An upstream error produces a validated local draft with no production write.

cases.title: Package builder rejects malformed provider identity output
cases.expectedOutcome: Forbidden provider identity fields are rejected and the route falls back to a local draft.

cases.title: Package provider context excludes tenant and user identifiers
cases.expectedOutcome: Only compact approved data categories reach the provider; identity and secret fields remain absent.

cases.title: Ask usage remains within latency and cost budgets
cases.expectedOutcome: Case latency and provider-reported token usage remain below explicit deterministic budgets.

cases.title: Ask mutation request carries the implemented refusal contract
cases.expectedOutcome: The read-only system prompt requires draft-or-discuss behavior and forbids any claim that a mutation occurred.
